run_equivalence.method: byte diff of both logs after normalising only the mutation child temp dir (inv07_<rand> -> inv07_TMP)
run_equivalence.note: the only per-run variance is the tempdir name of the mutation child copy

mutation_control.description: the harness copies the engine to a scratch tree, applies a coin-only (sleeve-key) mutation, and re-runs the same checks in a child process
mutation_control.exit_code_meaning: the MUTATION child process exit code (rc=1 = the mutated tree is caught)

non_vacuity.claim: the green run is not vacuous: a single coin-only mutation of the sleeve keying reddens 5 isolation checks and returns child rc=1

row ENG-INV-07's execution_proof in the same register still describes the runtime chain (leader event -> testnet order -> MASTER fill/position); this PASS is scoped to the in-process isolation half and does not discharge that chain.
